steps.title: Opposition Testing
steps.markdown:
This tutorial will guide you through running an opposition test on the OwnTech TWIST board.

Opposition testing lets two legs work against each other to measure losses at different duty cycles — without needing a real load.

Start by opening **Courseware → Hackathons → Opposition Testing** from the top menu.

steps.title: Upload the firmware
steps.markdown:
In the Opposition Testing panel:

1. Select your board's port from the **Target port** dropdown (click **Refresh** if the list is empty).
2. Click **Upload document to target** to flash the opposition-testing firmware.

Wait for the upload to finish before continuing.

steps.title: Load the dashboard
steps.markdown: Click **Load document dashboard** to load the pre-built Opposition Testing layout into the workspace.

steps.title: Power on
steps.markdown: In the **Action Buttons** pane, click **POWER ON** to enable the power stage.

steps.title: Enable LEG1
steps.markdown:
Under **LEG1** in the leg toggle grid, enable the **LEG** switch.

This activates leg 1 of the converter.

steps.title: Enable DRIVER1
steps.markdown: Under **LEG1**, enable the **DRIVER** switch to start the gate driver for leg 1.

steps.title: Set duty cycle to 0.5
steps.markdown:
In the **Setpoints** pane under **LEG1**, find the **Duty** row:

1. Type **0.5** in the duty input field.
2. Click **Send**.

The converter will run at 50% duty cycle.

steps.title: Tutorial complete
steps.markdown:
The opposition test is now running.

Monitor the measurements in the gauge panels and scope plot. You can adjust the duty cycle or toggle other legs in the same way.

Close this tutorial when you are done.
